comment: CLAUDE.md invariant 79. The engines inside the console image the manifests pin, as its labels say. Read with: docker buildx imagetools inspect <image> --format '{{json .Image}}' (linux/amd64 and linux/arm64), 2026-11-25. scripts/console-engines-are-the-stacks.sh holds this file to the manifests and, live, to the image's own labels.

lag.tokenfuse: The console's budget backtest runs tokenfuse v1.25.0 while the gateway runs v1.27.1. genaryx v0.1.0 carries the engine it was built with, as genaryx-console v1.14.0, pinned before it, did since stack-k8s 1.18.0 moved the gateway to v1.26.0. A genaryx release built with tokenfuse v1.27.1 closes it.
